competitive_landscape: The cluster runs today on seasonal conventional ferries, hydrofoils and diesel day-boats serving the marine park — proof of dense, established demand. The pain is timetable rigidity, wind cancellation of smaller craft, and a diesel fleet operating inside Europe's largest marine protected area. A quiet, clean, on-demand foiling layer directly answers all three.

navier_fit.pioneer_ii: Pioneer II is the native fit for the entire Sporades cluster — Skiathos→Skopelos (~10 nm), Skopelos→Alonnisos (~6 nm) and the Volos gateway (~30 nm) all sit well inside the 70 nm all-electric envelope, with quiet-mode, zero-wake operation purpose-suited to the marine park.

regulatory_note: Greek flag / EU; Hellenic Coast Guard certification. The National Marine Park of Alonnisos & Northern Sporades is administered by NECCA with zoned access rules — a clean, near-silent, zero-wake platform aligns directly with the park's mandate and is a strong differentiator for permitting. EU maritime-decarbonisation policy adds tailwind.
seasonality: The NW Aegean is calmer than the meltemi-exposed Cyclades, but afternoon etesian chop still builds in midsummer and cancels smaller boats; foiling flight above the surface keeps the ride smooth and the schedule reliable. The conservation calendar of the marine park (seal and seabird sensitivity) reinforces the case for quiet, low-wake operation.

summary: The Northern Sporades — Skiathos, Skopelos and Alonnisos — form the tightest, most sheltered island cluster in Greece, sitting in the calmer NW Aegean well inside the meltemi's worst reach. The hops are tiny (Skiathos→Skopelos ~10 nm, Skopelos→Alonnisos ~6 nm) and the whole eastern flank is wrapped by the National Marine Park of Alonnisos & Northern Sporades — the first marine park in Greece and the largest marine protected area in Europe at ~2,265 km². That combination — short protected legs plus a conservation mandate — makes near-silent, zero-wake foiling the natural fit, with Skiathos's UK/EU charter airport and the Volos mainland gateway feeding the demand.
tagline: Greece's tightest, most sheltered island cluster — wrapped around the largest marine park in Europe, made for quiet-mode foiling.
